name: map scrap
description: A torn corner of a prison plan. It marks the furnace, the gallery and the outer gate, but says nothing about reaching them.

name: iron bunk
description: A slab of iron bolted straight through the wall. It is not going anywhere, and neither are you by way of it.

name: iron key
description: A heavy key, blunt with wear, hung on a nail beside the storeroom door.
use_success_text: The iron key grinds once in the banded door and snaps off in the ward. The door swings open.
use_fail_text: There is nothing here this key will bite on.

name: lantern
description: A guard's hooded lantern. The reservoir is dry and the wick is stiff with age.
use_success_text: You fill the reservoir, and the wick takes with a soft thump of flame.
use_fail_text: The wick is bone dry. Without oil it will never catch.

name: rusted helmet
description: A guard's helmet, rusted through at the crown. It would not turn a raindrop.

name: oil flask
description: A stoppered flask bobbing at the waterline, still half full of lamp oil.

name: valve wheel
description: A spoked wheel lying loose in its crate, sized to fit the choked steam pipe.
use_success_text: You seat the wheel and haul. The pipe shudders, and the scalding steam vents away up the shaft.
use_fail_text: You cannot find the pipe coupling in this gloom, let alone seat the wheel on it.

name: bronze cog
description: A bronze cog with one freshly cut tooth: a spare, made for the gallery works.
use_success_text: You fit the cog and wind the works to the hour the ledger names. Deep in the wall, a bolt draws back.
use_fail_text: The cog seats easily enough, but the gallery clock could be wound to any hour at all. You would only be guessing.

name: ledger
description: The gate warden's ledger, still open at the day the prison emptied.
use_success_text: The last entry names the hour the gate clock was stopped. With a cog in hand, that number is finally worth something.
use_fail_text: Columns of hours and names. With no way to turn the gallery works, none of it means anything.

name: skeleton key
description: A long skeleton key on the clerk's ring, cut for the outer gate.
use_success_text: The drawn bolt lets the key turn at last. The outer gate groans open onto the courtyard.
use_fail_text: The key turns a quarter and stops. Something heavier than a lock is holding this gate.

name: stone mural
description: A carved mural of the prison at its founding, set flush into the wall. Cold, and immovable.
